note: Which scanners a run class must measure and which it may leave unmeasured (#763, docs/specs/qualification-adapter.md, 'The scanner roster'). Read by the adapter and the official-run driver. Not a component of the product policy revision: it names who is measured, not what a status requires, so it moves no support status.

openredaction.label: OpenRedaction default
openredaction.reason: The default (all-pattern) profile is slow and noisy for credential evaluation: personal data and resource identifiers dominate its findings, and its methods run takes 40+ minutes, so it is a manual measurement and never blocks other scanners or core verification (#763). Its earlier results stay as history with their run identity; a credential profile is a separate scanner, never spliced with it.
